feeds.feedDescription: Mindful Mentors is a podcast about becoming the person you’re capable of being. Hosted by Colton Edson and Frederick Maguire, the show explores mentorship, discipline, entrepreneurship, financial literacy, and the mindset shifts that turn potential into reality. Through honest conversations, personal stories, and interviews with builders, creators, and business owners, we unpack the habits, beliefs, and frameworks that create real freedom. This podcast is grounded, reflective, and built for people who envision more from themselves.
O radostech i trápeních se známými osobnostmi. Moderuje Kateřina Kubalová.

The weekly run down for true crime junkies. Each week we catch you up on what went down in the world of crime as well as discussing the latest must watch documentaries and chilling murder mysteries that keep us hooked. If you are a true crime junkie you’re in the right place.

items.episodeTitle: هل عقلك فوضوي؟ إليك كيفية تنظيم أفكارك بفعالية
items.episodeDescription:
إن كان الوضوح العقلي هو الحالة الذهنية التي يكون فيها الدماغ نشطاً وقادراً على التعرف إلى الأفكار؛ فإن العقل الفوضوي هي الحالة المعاكسة.

اضغط هنا لقراءة المقال.

items.episodeTitle: 6 طرق مثبتة علمياً لزيادة هرمونات السعادة في جسمك
items.episodeDescription:
هرمونات السعادة عبارة عن مواد كيميائية تنظم مشاعرك وحالتك المزاجية، ويمكن القول إن هناك بعض التداخل بين الهرمونات والناقلات العصبية.

اضغط هنا لقراءة المقال.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 17 Feed on the Chaos
items.episodeDescription: Being productive isn't about doing more—it's about doing what matters most. We share frameworks for prioritization, managing competing demands, and staying aligned with long-term goals.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 16 Wisdom Through Patterns
items.episodeDescription: In this episode of Mindful Mentors, we talk about how intuition isn’t magic — it’s often the result of pattern recognition, experience, and paying attention to reality. We break down why the most successful people in business become increasingly predictable over time, how historical data reveals the truth behind our habits and decisions, and why emotional thinking can distort judgment. From entrepreneurship and investing to relationships and personal growth, this conversation explores how better assumptions lead to better outcomes.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 15 Jeremy Issel
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we sit down with Jeremy Issel to walk through his career from the ground up. We get into his early work experiences, what those foundational jobs taught him about work ethic and responsibility, and how those lessons carried forward as he moved into more advanced roles.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 14 Origin Stories
items.episodeDescription: We accidentally skipped this episode in our Spotify upload order, so we’re bringing it back as Episode 15. Originally recorded as our Episode 10 milestone, this conversation goes deeper into the stories, experiences, and turning points that shaped who we are. We talk about childhood, hardship, near-death experiences, discipline, responsibility, gratitude, and the mentors that show up in unexpected forms.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 13 Jayme Cellitioci
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we sit down with Jayme Cellitioci to talk about invention education, creativity, and the role wonder plays in building a meaningful life. Jamie shares how her work designing learning experiences for kids has shaped the way she thinks about innovation, leadership, and helping people believe they can create real solutions in the world. We also talk about mentorship, ocean-inspired curiosity, impostor syndrome, and why some of the things that feel like weaknesses early in life can become your greatest strengths.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 12 Adjustments in Rhythm
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we talk about adaptability: how to stay disciplined without becoming rigid, how to adjust when life shifts, and why introspection is key to building a life that actually fits the season you’re in. We get into burnout, balance, complacency, perspective, and the importance of being able to reset when things don’t go to plan.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 11 Eli Munger
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we sit down with Eli — a longtime friend and someone who’s spent years studying markets, traveling the world, and working across the global wine industry. We dive into investing, economic cycles, and how markets really behave under pressure, along with what’s currently happening in the wine industry and where opportunity lies. Beyond that, this conversation expands into risk-taking, career pivots, and the value of betting on yourself early.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 10 Zoe Jet
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we’re joined by Zoe Jet — guitar builder, artist, and founder of Zoe Jet Guitars. We dive into her journey from musician to luthier, the power of apprenticeship, and what it looks like to learn a craft from the ground up. We talk about mentorship, perfectionism, impostor syndrome, and the mindset shifts that come with building something of your own.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 9 Skill Stacking
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we explore the concept of skill stacking — how combining multiple capabilities can create powerful leverage in your life and career. We talk about investing in yourself, identifying skill gaps, improving communication, and knowing when to learn something versus outsourcing it. From leadership and delegation to using tools like AI as leverage.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 8 Build Your Financial Foundation
items.episodeDescription: Money causes stress when you don’t understand it. In this episode, we simplify the fundamentals: assets vs liabilities, emergency funds, debt payoff strategy, and investing basics. We talk about credit cards, guaranteed returns from paying down principal, and why financial literacy reduces anxiety. The goal isn’t to look rich — it’s to build real stability.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 7 Foundation First, Philanthropy Second
items.episodeDescription: Giving isn’t just about money — it’s about alignment. In this episode, we break down modern philanthropy, mentorship as service, and the importance of building stability before trying to save the world. We explore how abundance fuels generosity and why sustainable impact starts with personal responsibility. A rising tide really can raise all ships — but first, you have to build your own boat.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 6 Be a Generalist
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we talk about why being a generalist might be your biggest advantage — especially in your 20s. We break down skill stacking, trying different industries, learning fast, and staying adaptable in an AI-driven world. From closing businesses without shame to raising your rates as your value grows, this conversation is about appreciation of the process.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 5 Deep Work in a Distracted World
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we break down how to reclaim your focus. We talk about deep work, procrastination, and protecting your bandwidth in a world built to distract you. From building rituals and structuring your environment to reducing cheap dopamine hits, this conversation is about training discipline like a muscle. If you want to produce at a higher level without burning out, this episode gives you the framework.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 4 Leverage Through Integrity
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we break down why relationships are leverage — in business and in life. We talk about boundaries, integrity, and the long game: showing up consistently, building trust, and choosing good people over fast growth. This conversation is about building long-term visions with long-term people — and understanding that your network is a direct reflection of your character.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 3 Discipline Over Dopamine
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we explore the concept of “time debt” — how overcommitting, social pressure, and constant stimulation quietly steal your bandwidth. We talk about auditing your environment, managing dopamine, cultivating your algorithm intentionally, and choosing discipline over motivation. From rituals and emotional regulation to comparison, obsession, and tradeoffs, this conversation is about protecting your focus in a distracted world.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 2 From Ideas to Income
items.episodeDescription: Thinking about starting a business or changing your career path but not sure where to begin? In this episode, we break down a practical one-year roadmap for launching while keeping stability in your life. From identifying monetizable skills and validating demand to structuring your business properly and avoiding lifestyle creep, we walk through the phases of proof of concept, build, and scale. We also talk about paying off high-interest debt first, reinvesting early profits, and managing stress without burning out

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 1 Redefining Mentorship in the Modern World
items.episodeDescription: In our first episode, we redefine mentorship. It’s not just a formal relationship — it’s the people, systems, algorithms, and experiences shaping you every day. We talk about positive and negative mentors, how social media influences your thinking, and why financial literacy is a modern survival skill. From Roth IRAs and compound interest to entrepreneurship and identity shifts, this episode lays the foundation for the Mindful Mentors philosophy: discipline creates freedom, mentorship is everywhere, and everything is figure-outable.

items.episodeTitle: Ep 18. Momentum
items.episodeDescription: Life becomes much easier once momentum is on your side. Whether you're building a business, growing your finances, or improving your health, every positive action makes the next one a little easier. We explore the compounding nature of effort and why success often feels slow until momentum begins to take over.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 19 Austin Robinson
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, Austin Robinson joins us to share his experiences co-founding Happy Bat Solutions and helping grow a mission-driven company focused on wildlife conservation and humane solutions. We discuss entrepreneurship, personal growth, problem-solving, and the lessons that come from taking ownership of your future.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 20 Investing In Todays Economy
items.episodeDescription: Today's market can feel disconnected from reality. Companies with little revenue are reaching massive valuations, new IPOs are making headlines overnight, and speculation seems to be everywhere. In this episode, we dive into the current investing landscape, discussing how to separate hype from fundamentals, manage risk during uncertain times, and remain confident in a long-term investment strategy despite the volatility.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 21 - Identity and Confidence
items.episodeDescription: In this episode, we discuss identity change, social media comparison, complacency, and the false belief that we always have more time.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 22 Space Is Cool & Counter Positioning in Business
items.episodeDescription: In this episode we are joined again by Eli Munger where we break down the historic SpaceX IPO, the growing space economy, and what expanding into the Moon and Mars really means for the future. We finish with discussing counter-positioning and how to build a real competitive edge by doing what your competitors aren't willing to do.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 23 Summer Recap and Life Audit
items.episodeDescription: Season 2 kicks off recapping our summer trips and doing a full life alignment check — what's working, what's shifting, and where we're headed next.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 24 Adam Halleck - Zen and the Art of Dog training
items.episodeDescription:
Sit down with us this week as we reconnect with Adam Halleck, owner of Adam Trains Dogs and author of Zen and the Art of Dog Training. Adam embodies personal growth through the lens of working with the purest souls on planet earth — man's best friend. This episode is chock-full of golden nuggets on how to think about training your dog, and how to live a life full of joy and purpose.


Book Link:

https://www.barnesandnoble.com/w/zen-and-the-art-of-dog-training-adam-halleck/1148610845?ean=9798987586648

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 25 Trust the Process
items.episodeDescription: Join us for some personal stories on how understanding your patterns and recording your goals and progress can help you to more deeply trust the process and stay true to the path that will allow you to reach your wildest dreams.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 26 Step 1 To Starting Your Business
items.episodeDescription:
Do you want to make some extra money in today's economy? Today we sit down to discuss tangible ways to think about identifying opportunities in the market. Our conversation details how to break out a business opportunity once we've identified it.

After listening today, you will have a thorough framework to use for brainstorming and stress testing your next side hustle.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 27 Paragliding and Pushing Your Own limits
items.episodeDescription: In this episode Colton talks about his recent experience in a paragliding SIV course as we discuss fear, extreme sports, staying humble and checking your ego when pushing your own limits.

items.episodeTitle: Ep. 28 Dealing With Deregulation
items.episodeDescription: Today we dive into us both feeling a little out of whack, how we got there and how to get back on track.

items.episodeTitle: Weekly Crime Wrap Up - 21st September 2025
items.episodeDescription:
This week we dive into the biggest crime stories making headlines across Australia and the world — from shocking murders to high-profile trials that have the public gripped. We’ll unpack the latest updates on cases involving Alan Jones, Dr Neil Hopper, the Menendez Brothers, and the so-called Tesla Murder.

But that’s not all. We’re also talking about the must-watch true crime shows and documentaries dominating screens right now, including Netflix’s Beauty and the Bester and Con Mum, as well as the UK detective series Patience. Whether you’re a long-time true crime fan or just dipping into the genre, we’ll help you sort through what’s worth your time.

Join us as we cover the crimes, courts, and content everyone’s talking about this week

items.episodeTitle: Jsem životní rváč. Ale ze vztahu s manipulátorem se vzpamatovávám doteď, vypráví Michaela Nosková
items.episodeDescription:
Narodila se v Brně a v 18 letech se rozhodla, že se stane zpěvačkou. Zazářila v soutěži Česko hledá SuperStar, později si vyzkoušela celou řadu muzikálů a jevišť u nás i v zahraničí. Dnes ji můžeme vidět například v muzikálu Ples upírů nebo v představení Céline Show, na kterém se podílí také jako producentka. V pořadu Až na dřeň mluvila Michaela Nosková nejen o adrenalinu, který jí pomáhá zvládat těžké situace, ale také o domácím násilí, kterým si prošla.

items.episodeTitle: Crime Weekly Review - 7 December 2025
items.episodeDescription:
In this week’s deep-dive, we unpack some of the most talked-about stories shaking Australia and the world. We begin with a landmark sexual-assault case in NSW involving the sex-work industry, exploring what this ruling could mean for future prosecutions and protections.

We also break down the recent lifting of a suppression order in the Greg Lynn case—a development that’s prompted fresh questions and public scrutiny surrounding previously undisclosed details connected to Lynn’s past.

From there, we move to Hollywood, discussing the latest criminal proceedings linked to the tragic drug-related death of actor Matthew Perry.

On the TV front, we review the headline-making, boundary-pushing Season 3 of Netflix’s The Diplomat, dig into the true-crime docuseries Missing: Dead or Alive, and talk about the wildly successful I Catch Killers  podcast with a focus on the episode Sydney’s Ketamine Queen Kerrin Hofstrand.

A packed episode—thought-provoking, timely, and not to be missed.

items.episodeTitle: Crime Weekly Review - 15 February 2026
items.episodeDescription:
This week on Killer Kontent, we’re deep in the courtroom and across your streaming queue.

We unpack the trial of Raymond Reddington, now facing trial over the 1986 disappearance and alleged murder of his wife, Sharon Fulton. Nearly four decades on, it’s a “no body” case built on circumstantial evidence, shifting stories, and a bitter separation.

Then, we head to Perth’s western suburbs, where architect Louise St John Kennedy and her neighbour Prudence Manners found themselves in court after a neighbourhood parking dispute spiralled into allegations of knife threats and assault along with some unedifying insults!

We also examine the death of high-profile lawyer Mark Dennis, which leads a broader conversation about exploitation in the charity sector.

In TV, we review the Netflix documentary The Investigation of Lucy Letby, exploring the case that shocked the UK, and the Scandi noir crime drama Land of Sins — is it worth your time or just another bleak binge?

Plus, Anne reviews the podcast Three Doors Down and tells us whether it deserves a spot in your feed.

Crime, controversy, what to watch next along with a few laughs— it’s all in this week’s Killer Kontent.

Proč je v poslední době opatrná na sociálních sítích? Proč se jako dítě musela potýkat s pocitem jinakosti? A co svým potomkům neustále opakuje?

This week, we’re diving headfirst into crime, court cases and culture.

We unpack the scandal swirling around the arrest of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, the bizarre mistaken kidnapping of an elderly Sydney man as well as give an update in the Nancy Guthrie missing person case. We also discuss a chilling Austrian court case in which a man stands trial after his girlfriend’ dies on a mountain hike in th middle of winters.

We discuss the classic UK drama Netflix’s Agatha Christie’s Seven Dials,  the Australian documentary Last Stop Larrimah reminds us that small towns can have very big characters and the gripping New Yorker interview with Giselle Pelicot as well as the BBC podcast Paradise.
